question_updates.question_en: A patient identifies isolated letters but reads continuous text very slowly. Which factor should be specifically investigated during reading assessment?
options: Crowding, reduced visual span or unstable fixation
Reduced colour discrimination alone
An isolated reduction in distance acuity only
A change in intraocular pressure during reading
question_updates.explanation_en: Continuous-text performance may reveal crowding, reduced visual span, fixation instability or a central scotoma that isolated optotypes do not adequately test.
question_updates.explanation_ar: قد يكشف النص المتصل التزاحم البصري أو محدودية المجال البصري الوظيفي أو عدم ثبات التثبيت أو وجود عتمة مركزية؛ وهي عوامل لا تظهر بوضوح عند اختبار الحروف المنفردة.

question_updates.question_en: A patient with retinal disease reports discomfort in bright sunlight but also struggles indoors. What is the most appropriate approach to filter selection?
options: Trial several appropriate tints under indoor and outdoor conditions
Select the darkest available filter without testing
Use a filter that blocks all visible light
Avoid assessing the patient’s indoor visual function
question_updates.explanation_en: Filter selection should be individualized and tested across relevant lighting conditions; excessive tint may reduce retinal illumination and impair indoor function.
question_updates.explanation_ar: يجب اختيار المرشح بصورة فردية وتجربته في ظروف إضاءة مختلفة؛ فالدرجة الداكنة جداً قد تقلل الضوء الواصل للشبكية وتضعف الرؤية داخل المباني.

question_updates.question_en: Two task lamps provide similar illuminance, but one causes disabling reflections from the page. Which adjustment is most appropriate to trial first?
options: Reposition and angle the lamp to reduce reflected glare
Increase lamp intensity to the maximum setting
Place the lamp directly in the patient’s line of sight
Replace the task material with a glossy surface
question_updates.explanation_en: Changing lamp position and angle, while avoiding direct reflections into the eyes, may improve task visibility without simply increasing illuminance.
question_updates.explanation_ar: تعديل موضع المصباح وزاويته مع منع انعكاس الضوء مباشرة نحو العين قد يحسن الرؤية دون زيادة شدة الإضاءة عشوائياً.

question_updates.question_en: A patient can read with a high-powered magnifier but loses the next word while scanning. Which principle should guide the final device choice?
options: The lowest power that provides adequate print resolution and usable field
The highest power available, regardless of field loss
The device with the longest working distance in every case
The device requiring no practice or adaptation
question_updates.explanation_en: The lowest magnification that meets the required print size often preserves a larger field and makes tracking easier; task performance must be verified.
question_updates.explanation_ar: اختيار أقل تكبير يحقق حجم الحروف المطلوب يساعد غالباً في المحافظة على مجال رؤية أكبر ويسهل تتبع السطور، مع ضرورة اختبار الأداء الفعلي.

question_updates.question_en: A patient moves a reading target from 40 cm to 20 cm without an optical aid. Assuming the same target size and viewing conditions, what is the approximate relative distance magnification?
question_updates.explanation_en: Relative distance magnification is the original viewing distance divided by the new viewing distance: 40/20 = 2×.
question_updates.explanation_ar: التكبير النسبي بالمسافة يساوي المسافة الأصلية مقسومة على المسافة الجديدة: 40/20 = مرتان.

question_updates.question_en: A digitally enlarged document is easier to resolve, but the patient loses the beginning of each line while navigating. What should be assessed next?
options: Visible text area, navigation, line spacing and place-keeping
Screen brightness alone, without observing reading
The file format without testing access
The colour of the device casing
question_updates.explanation_en: Enlargement should be balanced against the amount of text visible, navigation demands, line spacing and the patient’s ability to maintain place.
question_updates.explanation_ar: ينبغي تقييم التوازن بين حجم النص والمساحة الظاهرة ومتطلبات التنقل وتباعد السطور وقدرة المريض على متابعة موضع القراءة.

question_updates.question_en: A patient uses a distance telescope to read a classroom board. Which training component is essential before independent use?
options: Target location, alignment, focusing and safe task-specific use
Continuous walking while looking through the telescope
Using maximum magnification before locating the target
Avoiding practice to prevent adaptation
question_updates.explanation_en: The patient needs practice locating the target, aligning the telescope, focusing and using it safely in the intended viewing situation.
question_updates.explanation_ar: يحتاج المريض إلى التدريب على تحديد الهدف ومحاذاة المنظار وضبط البؤرة واستخدامه بأمان في الموقف المقصود.

question_updates.question_en: A calculated near dioptric demand is 4.00 D at 25 cm. Why should this value not be prescribed automatically as the near addition?
options: Residual accommodation, refractive correction and functional working distance
The calculated demand alone, irrespective of the patient
Distance visual acuity without near assessment
Pupil colour and ocular dominance only
question_updates.explanation_en: The calculation describes the vergence demand at that distance; the final prescription must account for refractive correction, usable accommodation, working distance, posture and binocular status.
question_updates.explanation_ar: الحساب يوضح الطلب الديوبتري عند تلك المسافة فقط؛ أما الإضافة النهائية فتراعي التصحيح الانكساري والمطابقة المتاحة ومسافة العمل والوضعية وحالة الرؤية الثنائية.

question_updates.question_en: A patient is issued a new optical magnifier but cannot use it effectively at home. What is the most appropriate next step?
options: Provide task-specific training and reassess use in the real environment
Increase magnification immediately without observing technique
Assume non-use means the patient has no rehabilitation potential
Discontinue all follow-up after issuing the device
question_updates.explanation_en: Device provision should be accompanied by task-specific training and reassessment in the patient’s real environment; non-use may reflect handling or environmental barriers.
question_updates.explanation_ar: يجب أن يصاحب توفير الوسيلة تدريب عملي مرتبط بالمهمة وإعادة تقييم في بيئة المريض؛ فقد يرجع عدم الاستخدام إلى صعوبة التعامل أو عوائق بيئية.

question_updates.question_en: An older patient with hand tremor struggles to keep a handheld magnifier steady. Which modification is most appropriate to trial?
options: Trial a stand magnifier or supported electronic magnifier
Increase handheld magnifier power without testing stability
Ask the patient to hold the device farther away while reading
Remove all near aids and advise unaided reading
question_updates.explanation_en: A stand magnifier or a supported electronic aid may reduce the need for precise hand control; the choice should be tested for posture, field and task performance.
question_updates.explanation_ar: يمكن تجربة مكبر ثابت أو وسيلة إلكترونية مدعومة لتقليل الحاجة إلى التحكم الدقيق باليد، مع اختبار الوضعية والمجال والأداء الوظيفي.

audit: All 10 updated records retain their original IDs and remain unpublished. Validation confirmed four options per question, exactly one correct answer, and no Arabic option text.
